title: Ship the smallest thing that changes your mind
blurb: Most of my estimates were wrong because I was estimating the wrong thing. The point of a first version is information, not coverage.

title: Legacy code is just code that outlived its explanation
blurb: Nothing is legacy while the person who wrote it is still in the room. Documentation is mostly succession planning.

title: Ask what the deadline is protecting
blurb: Dates are usually a proxy for something else — a commitment, a fear, a budget cycle. Naming that thing changes the conversation.

title: Prefer boring infrastructure and interesting products
blurb: You get one novelty budget. I'd rather spend it where customers can see it.

title: Write the postmortem before the incident
blurb: If you can already guess what the writeup will say, you have your backlog.
